candidate.product: Phoenix Trello — a Trello tribute built with Elixir, the Phoenix Framework, React and Redux
candidate.suggestedEra: webpack-era React + Redux frontend inside a Phoenix application

purpose: Admit and immutably ingest one webpack/CRA-era legacy React MIT application for the Versionless production-readiness portfolio (T004, tranche one).

network.scope: acquisition-only; every step after acquisition is offline

notReached: https://codeload.github.com/bigardone/phoenix-trello/tar.gz/<validated-commit-sha> (archive, two byte-identical streams) — never requested, because the candidate failed the React version gate before acquisition

gatePolicy.note: For this candidate the licence gate passed, so every remaining gate was evaluated from the pinned tree rather than short-circuiting on the first failure. Evaluating them all costs only blob reads and produces a more useful terminal record for the reviewer.

revisionSelection.rule: prefer the newest pinnable revision that carries the fullest application state
revisionSelection.rationale: Every tag in this repository is older than the default-branch head, so pinning a tag would have pinned a strictly earlier and less complete state of the application. The packet permits pinning either a tag or a commit; the head commit sha is just as immutable as a tag object and is the newest state the project ever reached.

nonclaims: Starting this probe establishes no licence, revision identity, source integrity, dependency closure, framework version, build, browser behaviour, migration feasibility, pilot status, or production readiness.
The candidate was supplied to this unit as an unverified suggestion; only the admission gates decide.
